name: Conflict Boundary Preservation Registry
purpose: Formalize irreducible projection conflicts as structural information rather than resolution failures.

conflict_classes.definition: The structural tension between transition-based (QM-like) and flow-based (GR-like) projections.
The tension between localized process resolution and global continuation requirements.
The tension between discrete participation thresholding and continuous constraint flow.
Conflicts arising from the feedback between embedded participation and induced geometry.
The tension between embedded observer limits and the assumption of external viewpoint metadata.

governance_rules.rule: Conflict preservation is a mandatory requirement for all reconstruction-topology artifacts.
Conflict erasure counts as critical topology distortion and triggers automatic rejection.
Forced unity language (e.g., 'unified field') triggers an immediate governance review.

forbidden_claims: Reconstruction topology resolves the discrete/continuous conflict.
Unity language replaces conflict preservation metadata.
Geometric smoothing justifies the erasure of local process thresholds.
